title: From geometry to a checked design

lessons.title: Understand the problem
lessons.description: Identify the design area, fixed edge and force. Predict the deformation before computing it.

lessons.title: Build the domain
lessons.description: Connect the boundary, choose a cell size and inspect the active grid.

lessons.title: Add supports and loads
lessons.description: Select the constrained edge and loaded point. Check the actual selected nodes.

lessons.title: Run the first FEM analysis
lessons.description: Choose consistent material and units. Read the baseline response.

lessons.title: Optimise the structure
lessons.description: Set a material budget and interpret density, compliance and termination.

lessons.title: Extract and check the shape
lessons.description: Apply a threshold and reanalyse the extracted geometry.

lessons.title: Apply the workflow to the roof rib
lessons.description: Recognise the same modelling stages in a prepared multi-case example.

lessons.title: Discuss the results
lessons.description: Compare predictions and results. Explain what the model can and cannot establish.
